Name: Better Furnace
Author: Toskopado
Description:
This mod adds a new furnace that allows you to smelt 5 ores at a time, consuming less coal and being faster!
ㅤ
The furnace consumes 25 ores (or 5 quartz), 4 coal, and produces 5 metal bars (with slightly faster speed)!
ㅤ
Recipe: 99 stones, 15 iron bars, and 5 clay.
ㅤ
Unlock the recipe at mining level 6!

(Works with the automate mod if you install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMautomate[/url])
